commonAdmissionGap: Program speaker metadata is a discovery lead only; verify identity, scope fit, two independent substantive technical works, personal/team attribution and at least one readable mechanism body before admission.
sourceRetention: Raw PDFs and text extracts retained only in temporary research scratch; publication record stores names, event metadata and locators, not talk bodies or contact details.
speakerVsAuthorRule: A program-listed speaker or panelist is not thereby the sole technical author. Recurring talks may be same project and never establish independence by themselves.
existingCandidateAssessment: No prioritized missing name matched a current pending candidate identity. John Wuu, Gerald Pasdast and Peipei Zhou have prior coauthor/source mentions; those are not prior candidate assessments.
